purpose: Frozen machine-readable reference copy of the 50 section requirements in the bundled Markdown contract. Existing consumers still require their configured Markdown or database inputs; this JSON is not a drop-in replacement.

does_not_supersede.note: The 48-section corrective profile remains the governing corrective contract. This 50-section artifact is a different object with a different consumer set. Neither replaces the other; the filename 'full30' is historical and does not describe its 48-section content.

source_document.note: Rows copied verbatim with the same regex the consumers use. The source document MUST NOT be edited in place: consumer configs pin it by sha256, so an edit silently invalidates every pinned selection config.

consumers_requiring_exactly_50.contract_source: selection config key contract.path, pinned by contract.sha256
config key sources.current50_contract, pinned by its sha256
section_relevance table count in the bound database
path arg current50_contract, compared to section_profile.contract_text

known_hazard: A caller-supplied path and hash identify a selected input but do not independently establish its authority. Compare the selected Markdown against source_document.sha256 and the recorded requirements. Existing consumer pin, database profile and shape checks remain required.
claim_safety: Section requirements are scope statements for what a Mode-B section must address. Presence of a requirement row is not evidence, and this artifact makes no biological claim and admits nothing. Judgment deferred.

sections.requirement: Exact four-part identity; assembly/profile; region interval and sequence/CDS binding; protein-hash/neighborhood identity policy; canonical versus source-local alias distinction.
Evidence-based selection rationale; current triage context; why this exact locus merits attention; no score-as-truth shortcut.
Exact boundary geometry; truncation/overmerge assessment; displayed exact/context denominators; what assembly state permits and prevents.
Short gene-role overview and pointer to §50. Preserve exact/context membership and the core, tailoring, transport, regulator and context distinctions without duplicating the full table.

Exact committed-step genes; reaction-level roles; conditional ordered pathway; minimal-gene-set/on-contig audit; strongest false-positive alternative; evidence for/against; positive and negative claim ceilings.
Direct tailoring candidates separated from broad metabolic context; conditional order; non-diagnostic families; comparator conflicts; coupling evidence; discriminating tests.

Independent transport, resistance, and regulation adjudications; direction/substrate/mechanism/operon holds; no proximity-to-function leap; no exact-bound evidence distinguished from biological absence.
KCB, MIBiG, ClusterBlast, and named comparator convergence/conflict; gene coverage and core-versus-generic-flank distinction; similarity never identity.
At least two locus-specific alternatives when evidence permits; strongest rival model; observations that discriminate each model.
Fragment/co-capture/overmerge risks; exact edge distances; partner-locus possibilities; RG-GMCI claim ceiling; no physical join without nucleotide proof.
Product-family capacity model from core grammar; exact compound held unless independently established; comparator conflicts retained.
Bee/microbe context from verified strain metadata and prevalence; chitin/ecology signals treated as strain context unless exact-locus coupled.
Class-level antibacterial/antifungal relevance; extract phenotype separated from locus attribution; literature claim and organism scope explicit.
Explicit forbidden claims: exact product, production, activity attribution, novelty, ecological function, physical linkage, and expression as applicable.
Typed remaining gaps only after accessible sources are searched; distinguish unavailable, unbound, not run, running, ingest gap, measured-none, and not applicable.
Current BLASTp/HMM/domain evidence plus only unresolved next tests; later nr/ClusteredNR additions are versioned, additive updates rather than a card-wide blocker.
Testable LC-MS/fermentation implications derived from the conditional product-family model; no predicted mass asserted as detected.

Lossless future-map payload requirements: every displayed gene, label, coordinates, strand, domains, selected genes, named matches and holds; V7 comparator preserved. Rendering remains a separate gate.

One integrated judgment and cross-cohort synthesis, preserving support, contradictions, strongest alternative, confidence, final claim ceiling and unresolved discriminating evidence. No publication-ready claim from mechanical checks.
Prioritized bounded actions with decision rules and owners; accessible evidence is obtained/reconciled rather than labeled pending.
For RiPP/NRPS-relevant loci, conditional precursor/monomer ladder with assumptions; otherwise reasoned not-applicable.
RiPP search scope, databases, precursor/maturation evidence and negative-result ceiling; otherwise reasoned not-applicable.
Heterologous-expression rationale, minimum construct and controls, host limitations, and result interpretation; otherwise reasoned not-applicable.
Novelty evidence decomposed into architecture, homology, cohort prevalence and comparator distance; “no hit” is not novelty.
Exact genomic-neighborhood conservation from ClusterBlast/current comparisons; core versus generic conserved context distinguished.
OSMAC plan tied to plausible pathway regulation/product chemistry and measurable outcomes; otherwise reasoned not-applicable.
Mechanism-specific self-resistance evidence, exact gene coupling, alternatives and required validation; broad transporter/family names are insufficient.
Claim-by-claim provenance; 14-stream disposition table; historical source-loss table; 50-row section reconciliation matrix.
Cross-cluster hypotheses with exact four-part partner identities, evidence state and physical-linkage ceiling; otherwise reasoned not-applicable.
Branching experimental decision tree: question, experiment, positive/negative decision rule, and program consequence.
Exact region CDS census plus boundary-context census; independently reconciled denominators; no denominator-difference identity failure.
Assembly-line enzyme/domain inventory from measured architecture; absent modules distinguished from unmeasured modules.
Module programming, substrate/extension/reduction logic and uncertainty; no collinearity assumption without support.
Initiation/loading and release/cyclization logic, candidate genes, alternatives and missing functions.
Per-protocluster decomposition for mixed/overmerged regions; each core and accessory set assigned or held separately.
Boundary, overmerge and locus-splitting adjudication integrated with exact intervals and sequence/CDS evidence.
Partner/accessory proteins classified as direct, plausible, broad context, or unbound; mechanism and coupling evidence stated.
Resistance/efflux signals with exact locus, mechanism specificity, direction, coupling and phenotype ceiling.
Cross-strain identity/coverage on exact orthologous genes/loci with denominators and channels; no alias-only comparison.
BiG-SCAPE family, cutoff, run receipt, cohort/reference membership and private/shared scope; new run may update additively.
Protein/domain phylogeny target, sequence binding, reference set, model limits and supported clade-level inference.
HGT/composition evidence relative to a declared genomic baseline; mobile/context alternatives; GC deviation alone is insufficient.
RG-GMCI/cross-contig candidates with exact partner identity, component signals and explicit “candidate, not nucleotide join” ceiling.
Within-cohort prevalence with exact numerator/denominator, profile/class definition and governed exclusions.
Supervisor/university cohort comparison with declared cohort, comparable denominator and source receipt; otherwise reasoned not-applicable.
Type/reference-strain comparison on exact comparable loci and genes, including Mamey/antiSMASH profile compatibility and divergence.
Host-matched unrelated reference comparison with verified host metadata, comparator rationale and transfer limits.
Biosynthetic gene, domain and machinery citations with explicit relevance to named genes, domain logic, alternatives or experiments; source scope and limits of transfer stated.
Genus secondary-metabolite and broader biological-context citations with explicit relevance; justify broader taxa/topics and distinguish reference phenotype from focal-strain evidence.
Complete contiguous named-match table formerly in §4, with unchanged full gene roster, geometry, protein binding, channel separation, result/admission states and typed holds.
